purpose: Fix what the six-cell proxy result may authorize before any candidate checkpoint or result exists.

authoritative_fields.integrity: analysis status and exactly six qualified frozen cells

branches.condition: analysis is missing, incomplete, outside the six frozen cells, or contains an integrity failure
branches.authorized_next: retain all evidence, stop automatic progression, and diagnose or preregister recovery
report the paired estimate and bound; use traces only for diagnosis; any redesigned comparison requires a successor contract

branches.condition: aggregate noninferiority passes but any source guardrail pass is false
branches.authorized_next: report every failed source and bound; do not average the failure away; any redesign requires a successor contract

branches.condition: fixed-token noninferiority and every source guardrail pass, hence proxy_quality_screen_pass is true
branches.authorized_next: materialize and separately qualify the frozen six-pair, twelve-run proxy-finalist design at 1,539,833,856 tokens per run

secondary_interpretation.time_to_quality_censoring: retain right-censored pairs; never form a complete-case confidence bound or change the quality branch
secondary_interpretation.fixed_flops_and_time: report descriptive paired summaries; they cannot rescue a failed quality screen
secondary_interpretation.runtime_startup: keep compilation/startup, validation, checkpoint, and orchestration outside steady training comparisons
secondary_interpretation.source_diagnostics: may locate failure modes but cannot credit individual architectural components

forbidden_after_any_branch: adding proxy pairs or changing the margin after seeing results
crediting KDA, NoPE, GQA, or the 3:1 mixer ratio
long-context or release claims from language loss
finalist_preconditions_if_eligible: materialization exactly matches future_finalist_design in baseline_matrix.json
all twelve output paths are unique and absent
storage is requalified for the finalist floor without deleting evidence
analysis and stopping rules are frozen for the six paired finalist cells
the exact hardware/runtime path is requalified before launch
candidate and dense controls remain paired within every seed/data-order cell
